story.heading: Built to scale your Amazon success
paragraphs: eCom Gliders began in 2018 with a single focus: help Amazon sellers grow with structured account management, not generic templates. Officially established as eCom Gliders LLC in 2022, we are now a team of 20+ in-house Amazon specialists.

We have helped clients generate more than $112M in Amazon sales while maintaining a 95% client retention rate. From new product launches to multi-marketplace expansion, our work spans PPC, listing optimization, catalog management, and full account oversight.
Every service is delivered internally by experienced team members. We are not a reseller of outsourced labor — we are a strategic partner invested in measurable outcomes for your brand.

items.question: Is eCom Gliders an in-house team or an outsourced reseller network?
items.answer: All core services — PPC, listings, creative, catalog, and account management — are delivered by our in-house specialists. We are not a reseller of rotating offshore freelancers.

items.question: Which Amazon marketplaces do you support?
items.answer: We support brands across the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, and European Union stores with localized listing and advertising strategy.

items.question: What happens in a free account audit?
items.answer: A strategist reviews your catalog and advertising posture, then outlines clear priorities — wasted spend, listing gaps, and what to fix first. There is no obligation to engage further.

items.question: How do you report progress?
items.answer: We operate on a structured optimization schedule with transparent reporting aligned to revenue goals, not vanity metrics alone.

items.question: How long have you managed Amazon accounts?
items.answer: We have been helping Amazon sellers since 2018 and were established as eCom Gliders LLC in 2022.
